tei:div.tei:p: bod du bla chen mkhan rgyud dang*/ 'dapu' klaspubla tsho mkhan rgyud/

paṇa chen mkhan rgyud rnams kyi byon tshul bzhugs so/ na mo bud dha ya/ thub bstan gangs ri'i khrod du gsal mdzad pa'i/ / smad 'dul byung khung mkhan rgyud rim pa ni/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po thugs sras sha ri'i bu/ /sras mchog sgra chen bram ze sgra can 'dzin/ /klu sgrub skyes mchog legs ldan dpal sbas dang*/ /ye shes snying po zhi ba 'tsho la 'dud/ /sbas ston rat+na gtsang ston rab gsal dang*/ /bla chen dgongs gsal shes rab seng ge dang*| |byang chub gzhon nu byang chub rgyal mtshan te/ 'jad pa ston skyabs byang ston gzhon nu zhabs/ /rtsis 'dul chen po mkhan po bde ba dpal/ /byang sems rin mgon thogs med bzang po dpal/ /yon tan 'od sogs bla chen mkhan rgyud kyi/ /sdom brtson dam pa rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /bla chen mkhan rgyud ni/ rgyal sras thogs med pa nas rgyud pa 'di dag par byed par yod do/ / na mo dhar ma ya/ thub bstan gsal zhing stod 'dul rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /'dapu klaspublatsho mkhan rgyud byon pa'i rim pa ni/ thub dbang sha ri'i bu dang sgra can 'dzin/ /legs 'dom nag po pa dang dha ri ka /grags mchog legs skyong rgya ba shes rab ste/ /mu gro 'dul 'dzin chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /byang sems zla rgyal dharma rgyal mtshan dang*/ /mnga' ris dgra bcom mkhan chen dbang phyug mdzes/ /mdzes pa 'od zer mdzes pa bzang po dang*/ /seng dpal kun mkhyen mdzes pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang*/ / shā kya rgyal mtshan dpu tsho mkhan rgyud kyi/ /slab gsum rgyan ldan rnams la gus pas 'dud/ / 'a dpu klaspublatsho mkhan rgyud stod 'dul gyi byung khungs 'di/ gtsang g.yas ru 'u yug zam tshe ba la rgyud pa 'di dag par byed do// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/ bla chen mkhan rgyud dang*/ spu tsho mkhan rgyud/ paṇa chen mkhan rgyud rnams byon tshul/ -PAGE 260--PAGE
